heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: What is a headless CMS?
items.answer: A headless CMS stores content and serves it through an API, so one editor can power web, mobile and other channels.

items.question: Can multiple editors work with different permissions?
items.answer: Yes. Role-based access and approval workflows are standard.

items.question: Will the CMS be SEO friendly?
items.answer: Yes. We build with clean markup, metadata controls and fast loading.

items.question: How long does cms development take?
items.answer: A focused system can go live in 8 to 12 weeks, while larger multi-department platforms take 4 to 9 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
